content.value: A biprism is placed at a distance of 5cm in front of a narrow slit, illuminated by (10) sodium light and the distance between the virtual sources is found to be 0.05cm. Find the width of the fringes observed in an eyepiece placed at a distance of 75cm from the biprism.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
